notes: Scan 007 carries the author’s page number 3 at the top and a separate small 6 at the lower left. There is no date or title. The page consists of three text paragraphs and a three-row display, with no independent drawing, insertion, deletion or prose marginal note.

The opening continues a construction of projective systems associated to fields and to pairs (K, Kbar). Display (4) states inverse-limit reconstructions for Pi_K, B_K and E_{Kbar/K}. The following paragraph says these objects can be reconstructed from the corresponding projective system, but not conversely. The final paragraph invokes the equivalence between Ind(corps.t.f) and corps and begins the consequence for the functors with deliberately doubled/heavy values. These statements are transcribed, not mathematically checked.

Confirmation crop crops/149_scan007_c02.png, original box [1120, 500, 1615, 625], verifies the upper sentence’s Kbar_i: the small terminal bent stroke and separated dot are present. It does not establish a general habit sufficient to remove the different doubtful denominator index in display (4), whose downstroke is not plain.

The ink has réconstitue with an initial accent (c04), du and singular correspondant (c05), and corps.t.f without a final stop after f (c06). These are diplomatic readings; none is regularized to the witnesses’ alternatives.

The first two signs of display (4) have three components, retained as cong (TeX \cong); the third is an arrow with a tilde above. The numeral at the left reads 4 on c03. No mathematical inference was needed to choose these signs.

The final three object letters have deliberate doubling/heavy retracing, unlike their plain earlier occurrences. Existing TeX conventions are followed with \mathbb{B}, \boldsymbol{\Pi}, and \mathbb{E}. H’s explanatory note about pro-objects is editorial and is not transcribed as ink. The map shafts show ordinary arrows, with no vertical mapsto bars.

No literal authorial doubt, correction or mathematical slip was established on this page. The denominator i in display (4) and final word allant remain editorial uncertainties. No external mathematical background or proof check was used.

Independent audit: all 11 boxes were read by reader_a, who had not read this leaf. Root inspected all eight differing boxes. The final word now records allant|elles; the rest retains the first reading, with explicit reasons in second/149_scan007_adjudications.tsv. The top-edge vertical trace in b08 was also inspected: it enters from neighboring context, outside the target baseline; neither reader supplies a prime from it.
